title: Service health
note: Returns ready when the API can reach its database. This does not guarantee fresh market references.

title: Trading configuration
note: Read configured ticks and execution fees. Use amm for product-specific rates. DerivativeLevels is the maximum per-side target before tick collisions and risk constraints.

title: Supported network and tokens
note: Read current generation and contract addresses before depositing. The currently implemented network is Ethereum Local, chain ID 31337, with three confirmations. BTC is an ERC-20 token here, not native Bitcoin.

title: Aggregated order book
note: instrument defaults to BTCUSDT. Bids descend, asks ascend. Each row is one aggregated price level, with cumulative BTC total. No individual public orders. Latest 100 trades; market high/low/volume/change use executed exchange trades over 24 hours.

title: Instruments, tickers and pools
note: Discover canonical IDs and status before trading. Perpetual symbol BTCUSDT maps to ID BTC-PERP. Last price and change may be null. IV and option marks are null when references are unsupported or stale. Index freshness threshold is five seconds.

title: Trade candles
note: instrument defaults to BTCUSDT; interval is 1m, 5m, 15m or 1h. Up to 500 candles. time is Unix seconds as a string. Candles derive from exchange executions, not external index prices; quiet periods may carry forward the last known close.

title: Create account
note: Email is normalized to lowercase. Assigns a unique random User######## username and default avatar. Password requires 10-128 characters including a letter and digit. Country is uppercase ISO alpha-2. Returns a 10-minute access token and sets a rotating 7-day HttpOnly refresh cookie.

title: Sign in
note: Returns access token and refresh cookie. Access tokens include a security version invalidated by account security changes. Invalid credentials return 401. Registration, login and refresh share a fixed-window limit of 30 requests per minute per IP.

title: Rotate session
note: Send novcic_refresh cookie. Rotation invalidates the old token. Reuse revokes its entire session family. Serialize refresh attempts per session.

title: Sign out
note: Revokes the refresh session family, if present, and clears its cookie. Already-issued access tokens expire normally.

title: Current account
note: Returns account ID, email, country, username and avatar.

title: My profile
note: Private profile, including optional date-only birth date. HMAC keys cannot access this route.

title: Update profile
note: Username: 3-24 ASCII letters, digits or underscores, case-insensitive unique. Avatar: default, fern, sunrise, river, mountain, moon, oak, meadow or fox. Birth date is optional, private and cannot be future. No command receipt required.

title: Change password
note: Requires current password and a new password of 10-128 characters including a letter and digit. Atomically revokes every refresh session and API key and immediately invalidates access tokens. Sign in again. Rate limited; no idempotency receipt.

title: Change email
note: Requires current password and a different unique normalized email. Email ownership is not verified. Immediately changes login address and revokes all sessions and API keys. Sign in again. No command receipt.

title: Wallet balances
note: Returns BTC and USDT wallets for Funding and Unified Trading. available plus locked is wallet total. Use risk.transferable values before transferring collateral out.

title: Account orders
note: All active orders plus the latest 200 closed account orders, descending sequence, then filtered to API-key product permissions. Closed TP/SL attempts are grouped to the latest per closingJobId. No cursor, offset or history export endpoint is implemented.

title: Account executions
note: Latest 200 account trades, descending sequence, then filtered to API-key product permissions. buyerId and sellerId determine your side. Public /market strips counterparty identity.

title: Account ledger
note: Latest 100 net wallet movements, descending ledger ID; zero-net reservations and releases are excluded before the limit. Signed deltas are exact decimal strings. Use referenceId to associate movements with operations; historical pagination is not implemented.

title: Risk and product positions
note: A consistent account snapshot. assets includes Funding and Unified Trading coin wallet balances, signed equity, mark-based P&L/option value, unsettled cash, transferable amounts and index-valued USD equity. risk distinguishes totalEquity from marginBalance, availableBalance and IMR/MMR percentages. Includes positions (including flat rows) with valuation, lifecycle and protection details, loans, supplies and DCA schedules; latest 100 risk events and liquidity requests. liquidityFees attributes actual BTC/USDT pool fee income using ownership at accrual, not current ownership. Fees remain compounded in NAV; this is cumulative reporting, not an unclaimed balance. Null amounts indicate unreconstructable history; since and completeHistory identify coverage. liquidityPerformance reports current share price/value, historical completed deposit and withdrawal USD totals, total P&L (current value + withdrawals - deposits), and nonannualized return on total deposits. Fees are included in NAV, not added again. Pending/cancelled requests are excluded. Missing historical values or unreconciled legacy shares make P&L unavailable. Funding balances are outside cross-margin equity.

title: Closed-position PnL history
note: Verified completed derivative lifecycles, ordered by closedAt descending then id descending. Partial exits accumulate until flat; reversal closes one row and starts another. All monetary values and counters are JSON strings. Actual opening/closing fees and signed funding are included. Owner and API-key product permissions apply before filters and pagination. Default 50 rows, maximum 100. Keep filters unchanged when following nextCursor; a cursor outside this account or filter returns 400. from/to are inclusive UTC closing dates. Older lifecycles with missing fees or untraceable funding/settlement are omitted rather than assigned estimated net P&L. New fills, funding and settlements update history atomically with accounting; delayed funding can update a closed row.

title: Transfer between accounts
note: Atomic wallet transfer. From and to must differ. Unified Trading outflows respect margin and option coverage; Funding-to-Trading top-ups remain possible during stale prices.

title: Place order
note: Price-time matching on the canonical instrument. Futures buy limits must be at most 110% of the fresh reference index; sell limits must be at least 90%. Lower buys and higher sells are allowed, subject to ordinary risk/tick rules. Adverse limits reject without automatic repricing. At execution, resting orders breaching their own side limit are cancelled; a valid passive order beyond the incoming side limit stays open and stops matching. Market and reduce-only orders cannot buy above the cap or sell below the floor. Reduce-only derivative orders reserve no new initial margin or fee capacity. Closing fees debit available USDT first; any shortfall becomes a signed USDT settlement liability with matching fee-recipient claims. Position size/direction, fresh prices and execution limits still apply. A successful HTTP response is not a guarantee of a full fill: inspect status, remaining and cancelReason. Market remainders cancel; no fabricated liquidity. Self-trade prevention cancels the incoming remainder.

title: Cancel order
note: Only your own open or partially-filled order may be cancelled. A new cancel intent for a closed order returns 400. Replaying the same successful command key returns its original receipt. A fill may win the race before cancellation.

title: Set position TP/SL
note: Perpetual, expiry futures and options. Entire-position, last-trade triggered OCO. Requires current lifecycleId/positionVersion and protectionVersion (0 for none). First triggered leg cancels sibling and starts durable reduce-only closing. Empty attempts update the same job without creating orders; retryDelayMs backs off from 100 ms to 1000 ms, resetting to 100 ms after a fill. Actual fills retain order and trade history. Attempts counts all checks, not just submitted orders. No hard attempt limit; serialization, reduce-only capacity and ordinary price checks apply. Closing-fee shortfalls accrue in signed USDT settlement rather than blocking the close. Same-direction additions are included; flat/reversal/expiry end the job. Cannot edit an active Closing job; stop it first. Both null remove protection. HMAC keys require the instrument product permission.

title: Stop automatic closing
note: Stops this owned lifecycle protection atomically. Requires current id/version and instrument permission. Already committed fills remain final; remaining position stays open. Read current protection from portfolio before requesting.

title: Amend a limit price
note: Atomically cancels/replaces the remaining quantity of an owned open/partially filled limit order. Uses opaque Order.version and matching instrument permission. Preserves prior fills; replacement has a new ID/priority and replacesId. Crossing price may execute immediately. Opening orders retain ordinary balance, margin and fee checks; reduce-only replacements use the same no-new-margin and fee-accrual rules as reduce-only placement. Futures replacements use the same directional limits as placement: buys at most 110% of the reference index; sells at least 90%; the passive side is not capped by this band. Failure leaves original order unchanged; same price is a no-op.

title: Cancel all open orders
note: Cancels open orders across all instruments for browser sessions, or only permitted products for HMAC keys. Releases reserved spot funds.

title: Update account leverage
note: Trade keys require both Perpetual and Future permissions. Integer 1-10. Applies immediately to all perpetual and expiry-futures positions and open orders. Insufficient margin rejects the entire change.

title: Preview account leverage
note: Read or Trade keys require both futures permissions. Rollback-only evaluation of the proposed account leverage and margin. No receipt or account change. Insufficient margin returns 400.

title: Preview order affordability
note: Price-based estimates with no depth cap or simulated execution. Market pricing uses last trade, otherwise reference index/theoretical option premium. Limit uses entered price. quantity=0 estimates Max. Reduce-only Max is the opposite open position size and is not capped by cash USDT or new margin; its fee estimate remains payable through settlement. Returns referencePrice and priceSource. No writes, sequence allocation or Idempotency-Key. Actual fills and risk revalidate on execution. HMAC keys require instrument product permission.

title: Settle derivative cash
note: Transfers signed USDT settlement claims, including fee receivables, from funded clearing liquidity. Can settle partially; pending remains in risk.realizedCash. No cash is created to satisfy an unfunded profit claim.

title: Deposit address
note: Returns the account deposit address, creating it once if needed. The same address is used for supported ERC-20 tokens. This route is naturally idempotent and does not use command receipts.

title: Deposit and withdrawal history
note: Latest 100 deposits and withdrawals. Private signing keys, raw transactions and internal sweep/gas jobs are excluded. Poll this endpoint for finality.

title: Request withdrawal
note: Debits Funding atomically and queues signing/broadcast. BTC supports eight decimals; USDT six. Destination must be a nonzero 0x address with 40 hexadecimal digits. Final status appears in custody/history.

title: List API keys
note: Lists key metadata including expired/revoked keys. Secrets are never returned here. Signed API keys cannot manage keys.

title: Create API key
note: Name is required, maximum 60 characters. Scope is Read (Read-Only) or Trade (Read-Write). products selects Spot, Perpetual, Future and/or Option; omitted defaults to Spot. Permissions are immutable. Maximum ten unexpired active keys. Expiry is 90 days. Store secret from this one response; a retry creates another key.

title: Revoke API key
note: Revokes a key owned by the session account. Returns success even when no matching owned key exists. Naturally idempotent.

title: Subscribe to Earn
note: Moves Unified Trading funds to the lending pool and issues shares at the current pool unit value. Interest accrues before subscription.

title: Redeem Earn shares
note: amount means shares, not token amount. Queues shares and pays immediately to the extent that pool cash is available. Remaining queuedShares settle as liquidity returns.

title: Create collateralized loan
note: Requires the other asset as collateral, fresh index, available pool cash, and initial LTV at most 60%. Interest is variable with utilization.

title: Repay loan
note: Pays accrued interest before principal. Requested amount is capped at total debt; proportional collateral returns. Full repayment marks Repaid.

title: Add loan collateral
note: amount is in the existing loan collateralAsset. Only active loans owned by the account may be changed.

title: Queue liquidity contribution
note: Accepts either or both assets into escrow. An unbalanced contribution waits for real spot counterparties to reach approximately 50:50 value. Shares are issued only on activation at current NAV.

title: Queue liquidity redemption
note: Locks unqueued shares. Specify BTC or USDT for proceeds. Redemption waits for chosen-asset liquidity and collateral headroom; share value changes until execution.

title: Cancel pending liquidity request
note: Only Pending requests can be cancelled. Deposit cancellation returns remaining escrow assets; completed conversions remain final. Withdrawal cancellation unlocks shares.

title: Create recurring purchase
note: amount is positive USDT per purchase, up to six decimals. hours is 1, 24 or 168. Optional budget must cover at least one run. First run is scheduled one interval ahead; funds are not reserved.

title: Pause or resume purchase plan
note: Toggles paused state. Resume schedules a new run one interval from now. Reuse the same idempotency key when retrying to avoid toggling twice.

title: Retired add-liquidity
note: Returns 410 Gone. Use liquidity-deposit/liquidity-withdraw, or place ordinary spot orders against the integrated AMM.

title: Retired remove-liquidity
note: Returns 410 Gone. Use liquidity-deposit/liquidity-withdraw, or place ordinary spot orders against the integrated AMM.

title: Retired swap
note: Returns 410 Gone. Use liquidity-deposit/liquidity-withdraw, or place ordinary spot orders against the integrated AMM.

title: Disabled development faucet
note: Disabled in the configured exchange; returns 404. Local test funding is an operator CLI operation, not a public funding API.
